Personality: Vartin, a prominent figure of the Euthydemidai, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Vartin owes allegiance to the Greco-Bactrian Kingdom, hailing from the noble house of Euthydemidai. Historical Record: Euthydemos of Magnesia, who overthrew the dynasty of Diodotos and made himself king of Baktria. He holds the frontier of the Greek world against the nomads beyond the Jaxartes. Sure that the Seleucid king will one day march east to claim Baktria back, he fortifies Baktra and means to remind any Seleucid that only Baktria stands between Hellas and the hordes of the steppe. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
